happened: On January 20, 2025, President Trump signed Executive Order 14168, which defines sex as male or female and tells agencies not to treat sex as including gender identity. HHS stopped enforcing gender identity protections under its health nondiscrimination rule, and in June 2026 it published notice that a court had vacated those parts of the rule.

key_dates.event: Executive Order 14168 signed.
Federal court in Mississippi vacates gender identity parts of the 2024 Section 1557 rule.
HHS publishes notice of the vacatur.

legal: In Tennessee v. Kennedy, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Mississippi vacated the gender identity provisions of the 2024 Section 1557 rule on October 22, 2025.
closeness: The chapter wanted the Secretary's antidiscrimination statements to treat sex as separate from gender identity and sexual orientation. The executive order and HHS's actions do this for gender identity; I did not check the wording of the Secretary's own statements or anything on sexual orientation. Related to ch14-088 and ch14-159.
uncertain: The text of current HHS antidiscrimination statements was not reviewed. Newest source is from June 2026.

happened: In March 2026, HHS issued new Title X grant guidance that dropped some Biden-era standards. In 2026, HHS's Office of Population Affairs offered up to $4 million for an Infertility Training Center to help Title X clinics promote fertility awareness-based methods and body literacy. The notice also gives credit for engaging faith-based groups.

key_dates.event: New Title X continuation guidance issued.
Applications due for the Infertility Training Center.

legal: I found no court ruling on these changes.
closeness: The chapter wanted Title X to focus more on fertility awareness education and to end religious discrimination in grants. The training center does this for infertility care and invites faith-based partners, but I found no rule changing the whole program. Related to ch14-139.
uncertain: Whether the training center was awarded, and what the newer Title X funding notice for 2027 requires, were not reviewed. Newest source is from mid-2026.

happened: The President has used the Defense Production Act often since 2025. In March 2025, Executive Order 14241 used it to boost mineral production. In 2026, he issued several more Defense Production Act orders and findings, including on coal, power grid equipment and petroleum.

uncertain: Whether any of these uses involved HHS or medical supplies was not reviewed. Newest source is from September 2026.

happened: I found no proposed or final HHS rule setting out how the Office for Civil Rights enforces the Religious Freedom Restoration Act. HHS's August 2026 regulatory agenda lists a planned conscience rule for OCR, but no separate RFRA rule.

happened: On September 4, 2025, HHS's Office for Civil Rights sent a letter telling states in the Vaccines for Children Program that they and their providers must honor state religious and conscience exemptions from vaccine requirements.

key_dates.event: OCR letter to Vaccines for Children Program awardees.

legal: I found no court ruling on the letter.
closeness: The chapter wanted OCR to review religious accommodation requests from people who object to vaccines. OCR stepped into religious vaccine exemptions, but through state exemption laws in one program, not a general review process for individual requests.
uncertain: Whether OCR handles individual complaints, such as from health workers, was not confirmed. Newest source is from September 2025.
